legend: Loosely cohesive cells embedded in an extracellular matrix. The cells vary from round to spindle with a variable amount of cytoplasm and poorly defined cell borders. The nuclei are elongated and vary in size, shape, and chromasia. Occasional multinucleated cells with highly atypical nuclei are seen scattered among the spindle cells (Pap).
Spindle and occasional polygonal cells are haphazardly dispersed. The nuclei are elongated, vary in size, and exhibit mild pleomorphism and atypia (Giemsa).
Mildly crowded tissue fragment showing spindle cells with elongated and (in many cells) blunt-ended nuclei with variable nuclear pleomorphism embedded in a collagenous matrix (Giemsa).
Spindle cells in a tissue fragment show a vague fascicular architecture with enlarged, irregular, blunt-ended nuclei (transbronchial FNAB, liquid-based cytopathology, Pap).

Spindle cell carcinoma

·     Consists solely of neoplastic spindle cells

·     Markedly atypical or deceptively bland

{12604887; 7672783; 8199991}

·     Single cells, loose tissue fragments, and poorly formed fascicles

·     Pleomorphic spindle cells

·     Necrotic background

·     Numerous lymphocytes and neutrophils

{11391606; 21325803; 23323109}

Vimentin+, pancytokeratin+/−, TTF1+/−, p40+/−

{31824199}

MET exon 14–skipping mutations

{26847053}

Spindle cell neuroendocrine (carcinoid) tumour

·     Predominantly or entirely spindle cells

·     Fairly uniform in length

·     Organoid pattern or mesenchymal in appearance

·     Single cells or loosely cohesive cells, arranged haphazardly

·     Spindle cells

·     Cells are curved or form arches

·     Nuclei predominantly ovoid or spindle

·     Plexiform vessels (50%)

Typical carcinoid:

·     No cytopathological atypia, no necrosis, no mitoses

Atypical carcinoid:

·     Mild atypia, focal necrosis or mitosis

{21987437}

Pancytokeratin+/−, CD56+, chromogranin+, synaptophysin+, INSM1+

{21043816}

Mutations in MEN1 and in other chromatin-remodelling genes

{24670920}

Pulmonary blastoma

·     Primitive mesenchymal cells

·     Branching glandular structures resembling endometrioid carcinoma

·     Morule formation

Mesenchymal component:

·     Scattered single cells or cohesive cells

·     Oval to spindle cells

·     Uniform nuclei with fine chromatin and indistinct nucleoli

Epithelial component:

·     Cohesive tissue fragments

·     Slightly larger, round to ovoid or columnar cells

·     Grey-blue or pale cytoplasm

{1709089; 19937760}

Mesenchymal component:

Vimentin+, SMA+, β-catenin+, pancytokeratin+/−, desmin+/−, S100+/−

Epithelial component:

Pancytokeratin+, CK7+, EMA+, TTF1+, β-catenin+

{2301281}

CTNNB1 exon 3 missense mutations

{15223963}

Pulmonary artery intimal sarcoma

·     Poorly differentiated mesenchymal tumours

·     Fibroblastic and myofibroblastic differentiation

·     Occasionally leiomyosarcomatous, rhabdomyosarcomatous, or angiosarcomatous differentiation

{18779732; 16613346}

·     Loosely cohesive tissue fragments

·     Spindle cells and epithelioid cells

·     Varying amount of cytoplasm, poorly defined cell borders

·     Nuclei of variable size, irregular nuclear membrane

·     Coarse chromatin, prominent nucleoli

{30552756; 25745502; 9684587; 22130766}

Vimentin+, myogenin+/−, desmin+/−, S100+/−, ERG+/−, CD31+/−, SMA+/−

{27073558; 18779732; 16613346}

MDM2 amplification, PDGFRA amplification

{11213836; 20685895}

Leiomyosarcoma

·     Intersecting fascicles of spindle cells

·     Moderate to abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm

·     Elongated, blunt-ended (cigar-shaped) nuclei

·     Cytopathologically high-grade

·     Cohesive fascicles and dispersed cells

·     Different cell types: spindle cells, rounded/polygonal cells, pleomorphic tumour cells

·     Elongated, blunt-ended (cigar-shaped) nuclei

·     Enlarged irregular nuclei

·     Multinucleated tumour cells

{16900474}

Vimentin+, desmin+, SMA+, CD34−, pancytokeratin−, S100−, DOG1−

{26275258}

 

Synovial sarcoma

Monophasic synovial sarcoma:

·     Dense fascicles of monomorphic spindle cells

·     High N:C ratio

Biphasic synovial sarcoma:

·     Epithelial and spindle cell components in varying proportions

·     High cellularity and uniformity of cells

·     Cell tissue fragments with irregular borders and dispersed cells

·     Pericapillary arrangement

·     Mixture of round, oval, and spindle cells

·     Mitoses are numerous or occasional

{19267417; 31161693; 20730898}

BCL2+, pancytokeratin+, EMA+, CD99+, S100+/−, CD34−, SS18::SSX fusion-specific antibody+

{29893303; 32141887}

t(X;18)(p11.2;q11.2)

{29893303}

Spindle cell melanoma

·     Elongated, narrow, tapering cytoplasmic processes

·     Cohesive fascicles or whorls intermingled with scattered epithelioid tumour cells

·     Short or slender cells

·     Mild or moderate nuclear pleomorphism

·     Some cells extremely bland and uniform

·     Melanin pigment intracellular and extracellular

{18260089; 24107480}

S100+, SOX10+, HMB45+/−, melan-A (MART1)+/−, MART1+

{18260089; 25724000}

BRAF p.V600E

{22809251}

Sarcomatoid mesothelioma

·     Arranged in fascicles or in haphazard patterns

·     Elongated and tapered spindle cells

·     Nuclei that range from bland to pleomorphic

·     Hypocellular smears

·     Few cohesive tissue fragments

·     Atypical spindle cells

·     Collagenous stroma +/−

·     Primarily pleural-based

{16355399}

Pancytokeratin+, calretinin+/−, D2-40+, WT1+/−, vimentin+

{21043818; 19438742}

Homozygous del(9p21)

{26288396}

Gastrointestinal stromal tumour (GIST)

·     Arranged in fascicles or in a nested growth pattern

·     Hypocellular to densely cellular

·     Spindle and/or epithelioid cells

·     Eosinophilic and fibrillary cytoplasm

·     Elongated nuclei with fine chromatin

·     Cohesive tissue fragments

·     Spindle or epithelioid cells

·     Moderate amount of cytoplasm

·     Elongated, blunt-ended nuclei

·     Minimal nuclear atypia or pleomorphism

·     Mitoses and necrosis in malignant GIST

{16130141; 22351482}

KIT (CD117)+, DOG1+, SMA+/−, CD34+/−

{30218589}

KIT mutations, PDGFRA mutation, SDH alteration, BRAF p.V600E mutations

{31100836}

Inflammatory myofibroblastic tumour

·     Arranged in fascicles

·     Plump and spindle cells with indistinct cell borders

·     Chronic inflammatory infiltrate

·     Scantly cellular to hypercellular bland, fibroblast-like cells to spindle to epithelioid cells

·     Prominent atypia and prominent nucleoli

·     Rich in plasma cells and lymphocytes

{29673102; 27087029; 20730898; 21472870}

SMA+, ALK+

{11684952}

ALK rearrangement

{11485898; 25723109}

Solitary fibrous tumour

·     Patternless architecture

·     Staghorn vessels

·     Varying cellularity

·     Uniform fibroblastic spindle cells

·     Cellular tissue fragments with irregular fascicles with pink collagenous stroma

·     Low to moderate cellularity

·     Bland spindle cells with a fusiform nucleus

·     Finely dispersed chromatin and inconspicuous nucleolus

{28914981; 20209623}

CD34+, STAT6+

{23313954; 23313952}

NAB2::STAT6 gene fusions

Lymphangioleiomyomatosis

·     Variably sized cysts

·     Spindle cells with fine chromatin, small nucleoli, and granular eosinophilic cytoplasm

·     Loosely cohesive tissue fragments consisting of spindle cells with dispersed single spindle cells

·     Oval nuclei

{34000096}

SMA+, HMB45+, melan-A+, ER+, PR+, S100−

{8214254; 9720495}

 

Malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumour

·     Arranged in fascicles

·     Alternating cellularity

·     Densely cellular monomorphic spindle cells

·     Moderate to high cellularity

·     Elongated, slender, or wavy nuclei

·     Marked nuclear pleomorphism

·     Less commonly, a delicate, fibrillary, metachromatic stroma

{10097706}

S100+/−, SOX10+/−

 

Type A thymoma

·     Spindle and/or oval nuclei

·     Finely dispersed chromatin

·     Inconspicuous nucleoli

·     High cellularity

·     Elongated or elliptical nuclei in epithelial cells

·     Relative lack of lymphocytes

{18514125}

Pancytokeratin+, p63+, p40+

TTF1, thyroid transcription factor 1.
